topic.title: AI News: 4 Stories You Need to Know Today
topic.angle: daily AI digest with a money angle on every story
topic.visual_world: futuristic AI interfaces, data centers, robots, product demos

stories.title: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon Powers the New Pixel and a Generation of Co‑Authored Apps
stories.hook: Google just broke the model‑size wall and handed us a Gemini‑powered phone.
stories.angle: Gemini 4 Carbon launched with unprecedented multimodal collaboration, now rolling out in the Pixel 9 and Pixel Watch. The upgrade lets developers build fully‑AI‑driven creative tools and unlocks in‑device voice‑to‑code features.
stories.money_angle: Developers can cash in by publishing Gemini‑powered app extensions on the Play Store and use the new auto‑build API to generate revenue‑generating code on a pay‑per‑use basis.
stories.visual_world: Screenshots of the Pixel 9 with the Gemini UI, demo videos of a music‑mixing app created by Gemini, a live coding session where Gemini generates an entire app in real time.

stories.title: Alibaba Unveils Qwen4‑Max and Gives Game Developers a Free AI Engine
stories.hook: Alibaba’s new Qwen4‑Max promises to replace every Unity, Unreal, and Godot teacher.
stories.angle: Qwen4‑Max drops a 530‑Billion‑parameter model that can auto‑debug, design levels, and even generate 3D assets from plain text. Game studios can spin up full prototypes in minutes.
stories.money_angle: Indie devs and studios can monetize faster by using Qwen4‑Max to create high‑quality assets and levels on a subscription basis, reducing asset‑budget costs by up to 70 %.

stories.title: Meta’s Conductor Acquisition and Apple’s AI Acqui‑Hire Signal a Coding‑Automation Boom
stories.hook: Meta and Apple just joined forces with the next generation of no‑code AI coders.
stories.angle: Meta bought Conductor, a multi‑agent AI coding platform, while Apple hired the former NotebookLM team to accelerate its AI‑assisted development. Both moves aim to democratize enterprise software creation.
stories.money_angle: Freelance coders can use Conductor’s agent architecture to build applications faster and lock in higher hourly rates, while entrepreneurs can launch AI‑powered startups with less technical overhead.

stories.title: Nooks Secures $500 M to Expand Sales Automation Powered by AI
stories.hook: Nooks just raised half a billion dollars to turn sales reps into AI‑driven hyper‑scalers.
stories.angle: The funding will be used to scale Nooks’ AI gateway that integrates GPT‑powered conversation boosters with CRM workflows. The tool promises to cut sales cycle times by 30 % nationwide.
stories.money_angle: SMBs can adopt Nooks’ platform to automate email outreach and lead qualification, boosting revenue without hiring new reps.
